scope: Exact five existing resource pairs reviewed for meaning and UI; no existing translations or exception budget changes approved.

ShutdownIncomplete.zh-CN: 应用退出未完成，请重试退出。
ShutdownIncomplete.en-US: Shutdown did not complete. Retry closing Iris.

UpdateRecoveryCleanupPending.zh-CN: 部分清理尚未完成，重试会先完成清理。
UpdateRecoveryCleanupPending.en-US: Some cleanup is incomplete. Retrying will finish cleanup first.

UpdateRecoveryRequired.zh-CN: Iris 未能完成退出，更新尚未安装。已保留您确认的更新，请重试安装，或取消更新并退出。
UpdateRecoveryRequired.en-US: Iris could not finish closing, so the update has not been installed. Your confirmed update is retained. Retry installation, or cancel the update and exit.
